answer: Trust the check, not the claimant: Accredited scent trainer scent record with scent trainers certification is the check, and it reads three-year training, 180 supervised dogs, behaviour exam, annual renewal. Faking 379 identities means 379 fresh proofs and 113 POA each, while the honest path costs one proof and 16 minutes. The ocean is the evidence, the nadir is the expense, and the reef is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
